# truefoundry_agent_skill (Resource)

Manages an agent skill (`agent-skill` manifest) via `PUT /api/svc/v1/agent-skill-versions` — a versioned artifact in an ML repo (`truefoundry_ml_repo`) that agents (`truefoundry_agent`) reference by FQN. Every update creates a new immutable skill version on the control plane. The control plane ingests the applied source into TrueFoundry-managed blob storage, so the configured source cannot be read back: source changes made outside Terraform are not detected, and after `terraform import` (by name, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_agent_skill.example my-skill`) the first apply uploads the configured source as a new version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An agent skill is a versioned SKILL.md artifact in an ML repo that agents
# reference by FQN. The frontmatter name must match the skill name.
resource "truefoundry_agent_skill" "ticket_writing" {
  name    = "ticket-writing"
  ml_repo = truefoundry_ml_repo.gateway_artifacts.name

  source = {
    type     = "inline"
    skill_md = <<-EOT
      ---
      name: ticket-writing
      description: Write actionable support tickets
      ---
      # Ticket writing

      Summarize the problem in one sentence, then list reproduction steps.
    EOT
  }
}

# Attach a specific skill version to an agent by its versioned FQN.
resource "truefoundry_agent" "support_triage" {
  name        = "support-triage"
  description = "Triages inbound support tickets"

  model = {
    name = "my-openai-account/gpt-5-mini"
  }

  skills = [
    {
      fqn     = "${truefoundry_agent_skill.ticket_writing.fqn}:1"
      preload = true
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ml_repo` (String) Name of the ML repo the skill lives in. It must exist on the tenant. Changing it replaces the skill.
- `name` (String) Name of the agent skill (must start with a lowercase letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Changing it replaces the skill.
- `source` (Attributes) Where the skill's content comes from. `type` selects the variant; the other fields belong to one variant each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the agent skill, e.g. agent-skill:my-tenant/my-repo/my-skill. Agents reference a specific version by appending its number, e.g. `"${truefoundry_agent_skill.example.fqn}:1"`.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the agent skill.

<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Required:

- `type` (String) Source variant: `inline` (skill_md) or `blob-storage` (uri and description).

Optional:

- `description` (String) What the skill does, shown to agents (type `blob-storage`; inline sources carry it in the frontmatter).
- `skill_md` (String) The SKILL.md document (type `inline`). Must start with YAML frontmatter whose `name` field matches the skill name, e.g. via file() or a heredoc.
- `uri` (String) Blob storage URI the skill directory is ingested from (type `blob-storage`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agent skills are imported by their name. The configured source cannot be
# read back, so the first apply after an import uploads it as a new version.
terraform import truefoundry_agent_skill.ticket_writing ticket-writing
```
